title: CYCLIC-TRIPLEBOOST: explicit positive-phase suppliers with consolidated inverse-cubic-log block proof

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-TRIPLEBOOST configuration specified completely in proof.md, log_base.md and cyclic_base.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^J(n)). Here J(n)=a sqrt(n)+91sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^6-2800sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^12+186000sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^18 and G(n)=a sqrt(n)-11sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^3+91sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^6-(log2 n)^3, with exact Pell rational  of cyclic_base.md Section 0. These eventual positive representative envelopes are evaluated for n>=2^4096 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix; correctness covers every N. Constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This one configuration fixes counted inverse-cubic-log base x0=max(2,floor(mu/ell(mu)^3)), OTHER boost x=s=min(mu-1,x0+t^3), SEED boost x=s=min(mu-1,x0+t^3+2t), t=ceil(log2(n+2)), kappa=ceil(log2 mu)+1 for mu<65536 and kappa=2 otherwise, square-root blocks and all actual recomputed maxima, decoder/extractor modes, grids, precision/confidences and separate typed caps 4096 U_seed and 4096 U_other as specified in proof.md. Every rejected, failed, discarded and cutoff-abandoned original acquisition counts. The exact growth index is 1/2. Each power-of-two supplier explicitly applies X to the original control once after LE and before forming the labelled leaf, so its wide-block phase is positive.
